baseline: Crossref/task-103 registry fields at main 0bbd31a82406e1922509aa052885d214b6efff85; crossref_title and crossref_year are the governed comparison fields.
claim: The governed 117 DOI population has cross-source bibliographic metadata consistent between the registry/Crossref baseline and the OpenAlex Works oracle under the formal task-110 protocol.

contradiction_conditions.rule: canonical_id_match AND (title_ratio < 0.75 OR abs(year_delta) > 1 OR retraction mismatch)

e_axis_mapping.on_contradicted: Retain E1 ceiling and isolate contradiction; no scientific inference.
e_axis_mapping.on_invalid: No E-axis change; quarantine the invalid run.
e_axis_mapping.on_null: Retain E1 ceiling without promotion; record null/ambiguity limitation.
e_axis_mapping.on_partial: Retain E1 metadata-consistency ceiling and record itemized mismatches.
e_axis_mapping.on_supported: Retain metadata-consistency E1 ceiling; no promotion beyond the preregistered claim.

exclusions: No paper-content validity, scientific truth, Pointfire physics, MCF, PSD, ARN, causal validity or maturity/disposition promotion.

invalid_test_conditions.rule: HTTP/network acquisition failure after preregistered retries; never counted as support

null_conditions.rule: no unique exact normalized DOI match, missing required metadata, or unrecognized registry retraction status

null_or_comparison: NULL_OR_INCONCLUSIVE is assigned when no unique exact DOI-equal OpenAlex work or required metadata is available; duplicates are retained but excluded from the primary denominator.

partial_support_conditions.rule: canonical_id_match AND no hard contradiction AND (year_delta == 1 OR 0.75 <= title_ratio < 0.92)

scope: Cross-source bibliographic metadata consistency only; no paper-content, scientific-truth, Pointfire-physics, MCF, PSD or ARN validation.

source_acquisition.licence: OpenAlex API metadata; audit retention only

stopping_rule: Complete all 117 records; abort as a systemic blocker only if TEST_INVALID_OR_ABORTED exceeds 50 percent.

success_conditions.contradicted: canonical_id_match AND (title_ratio < 0.75 OR abs(year_delta) > 1 OR retraction mismatch)
success_conditions.duplicate_denominator: is_duplicate_doi=true records remain visible but are excluded from primary rates
success_conditions.invalid: HTTP/network acquisition failure after preregistered retries; never counted as support
success_conditions.null: no unique exact normalized DOI match, missing required metadata, or unrecognized registry retraction status
success_conditions.partial: canonical_id_match AND no hard contradiction AND (year_delta == 1 OR 0.75 <= title_ratio < 0.92)
success_conditions.supported: canonical_id_match AND title_ratio >= 0.92 AND abs(year_delta) <= 1 AND retraction_match

uncertainty: This is a full census of the locked population, not a sample estimate. Report exact counts and denominator; null/ambiguous records are not averaged into support.
